stemText: A solid sphere of mass M and radius R rolls purely without slipping down a rough slope that merges smoothly into a vertical circular loop of radius r_loop (case #2). What is the minimum release height H_min above the base of the loop to complete the loop without apex detachment?

Step 3: Integrate over spatial boundaries and equate energy / force balance.
